reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's v6 model end-to-end by porting tools/ladder2.py: per-platform wheelbase, refit K_us per platform from the canonical Ford segments, median per-platform integer-sample lag, and per-segment static steering offset fit by velocity-weighted LS.
notes: Re-ran agent's v6 from tools/ladder2.py: per-platform refit K, per-platform median lag, per-segment static steering offset; params and offsets fit on Ford data with |a_lat|<15 & v>5, then scored under canonical v_mps>2.0 filter. Per-segment offset fit on the same data it scores against (agent disclosed).
